name: Baizhi Agent Toolkit
description: Hosted tools for web search, page scraping, and structured extraction. Requires a Baizhi account and API key; usage can consume credits.
notes: Maintained by the Baizhi Cloud team. Tool inputs are sent to the hosted service. The server can expose additional capabilities; this catalog entry does not restrict the discovered tool set or grant automatic tool approval.
installHint: Create your own key in the Baizhi console, then enter the key without the Bearer prefix. Review the discovered tools and service costs before use. No local proxy is required.

auth.credentialHelp: Get your own key from the [Baizhi console](https://agent-toolkit.app.baizhi.cloud/). Enter only the key; it is sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Tool calls can consume service credits.
